method: Every directory under a path segment named legacy is grouped into units (legacy/<name>, or legacy/restored-from-main/<date>-<commit>/<name>). For each unit with source files: file count, source files by language, test files, package names from its package.json files, and activeTwins: non-legacy directories whose package.json carries one of those names or whose directory has the unit's basename. Units are ordered by source file count. activation is pending until a unit is migrated into its owner and recorded in a ledger.
